summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments on a batch upload pipeline PR, then perform comprehensive documentation maintenance: prune stale deferred items, update feature matrix, refresh README, create a filesystem specification, audit all docs/ files for staleness, and refresh the codebase map.
summary.outcome: All 4 PR review threads resolved (2 fixed, 1 not applicable, 1 doc fix), PR #419 created with 15 commits updating DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, ROADMAP.md, CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md, FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md (new), and codebase maps (TESTING.md, CONCERNS.md) refreshed via parallel mapper agents.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the live error tracking and remote log shipping solution — replaces any prior Sentry/Datadog/Loki plans.
FUSE write ops intentionally have no unit tests; coverage is provided by the Desktop E2E suite because unit testing would require mocking too much of the host OS.

15 republish schedule entries are failing with 'ECIES decryption failed for all available epochs' — these were enrolled before the Phala CVM migration (Phase 35) and are wrapped with an old TEE public key. The 477 newer entries are correctly enrolled.
The duplicate file upload path (replace/copy branch) still encrypts on the main thread via encryptFile() — Phase 37's Web Worker encryption only covers new file uploads.
folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) are still active despite SDK equivalents existing; migration is deferred to Phase 38.
The crypto package has @cipherbox/core as a devDependency only used in vault-ipns.test.ts to compare keypair derivation — a leftover from Phase 19.1 restructuring that should be removed.
Database has 14 tables total (not 12 as previously documented): includes share_invites and pin_migrations added in phases 28-37.
AES-256-CTR is used for large files (video AND audio) in both FUSE reads and client-side upload encryption; AES-256-GCM is for small files only.
Bin retention period: RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is an operator env var, not user-configurable — user-facing setting is planned for Phase 39.
Phala CVM TEE republish cycle runs every 6 hours (not 3h as previously documented in CLAUDE.md).
Old preliminary R&D docs moved from 00-Preliminary-R&D/ to .planning/milestones/m0/ as part of the main merge.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw, causing pending entries to leak — fixed with try/catch that cleans up the pending map on error.
Doc comment on uploadFiles() overstated memory bounding — fixed to clarify actual behavior.
Batch reads all files to memory before SDK call — architectural limitation requiring SDK contract change (File objects vs Uint8Array), deferred as lazy file reading item.
Individual result failures (success: false) from TEE are not logged at the TeeService level — error detail only visible via direct DB query on the republish schedule table.
Only consumer of @cipherbox/core devDependency in the crypto package — test could use hardcoded test vectors instead, eliminating the cross-package test dependency.

workflow: When asked to prune a list, do every item systematically — not just the ones the user explicitly calls out. Shallow passes that miss items require multiple correction rounds.
GraphQL reviewThreads query with isResolved filter is the reliable way to fetch unresolved PR threads; REST comment replies require --field (integer) not -f for in_reply_to.
Operator env vars and user-facing settings are distinct concepts — don't conflate them when triaging deferred items.
The gsd-codebase-mapper agents write documents directly and return only confirmations with line counts — orchestrator should not request document contents back.
Parallel mapper agents (run_in_background=true) complete independently; handle task notifications as they arrive rather than waiting for all before proceeding.

friction: Multiple rounds needed to properly clean DEFERRED.md — initial pass only removed items the user explicitly flagged rather than systematically verifying every item.
Edit tool reformatted table whitespace, making exact-string matching for subsequent edits fail — required reading the raw file content via bash to get exact formatting before editing.
DEFERRED.md required 6+ separate editing sessions due to incremental user corrections rather than one thorough audit upfront.
Commit subject line rejected by pre-commit hook when using parentheses — had to retry with dashes (e.g. 'fix - fuse' instead of 'fix(fuse)').
PR already existed when trying to create it — had to update description instead of creating new.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts and bin.service.ts (migrate 9 importers to SDK), remove @cipherbox/core devDependency from crypto package.
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — bin retention period, soft vs hard delete toggle, versioning defaults (max versions, cooldown period).
15 stale republish entries with old TEE public key — will keep failing until those clients reconnect and re-enroll, DB-cached CID fallback covers resolution in the meantime.
Duplicate file upload path (replace/copy branch) still encrypts on main thread — needs migration to Web Worker path started in Phase 37.
useDropUpload.ts has no unit tests despite being significantly rewritten in Phase 37 as the primary upload entry point.
SDK and SDK-core packages have 11+ console.warn calls that bypass Faro transport — structured logging from Phase 28 didn't cover zero-dependency packages.
Lazy file reading within concurrency pool (useDropUpload.ts:140) — requires SDK contract change to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array.
Phala Cloud CVM is single TEE provider with no fallback — Docker simulator removed in Phase 35 along with any alternative provider path.
Faro telemetry scrub relies on key-name allow-list — new attack surface introduced in Phase 30 that warrants ongoing review as new fields are added.
